findings.summary: Repository recovery reconciliation does not bind observation resource or rollback postcondition to the durable compensation PreparedAction.
findings.required_change: Bounded-load the exact durable compensation PreparedAction at the repository boundary and reject wrong resource or expected postcondition with zero writes.

findings.summary: Raw receipt durability and the process-shared at-most-once crash oracle do not satisfy the approved crash matrix.
findings.required_change: Publish the bounded receipt object before the receipt event commit, add before/after fault cuts, and persist aggregate cross-process invocation counts with a known-fault oracle.
